lib/paint/style: A style's brushes come from the packs imported into it.
lib/paint/brush-fidelity: A sheet reads an imported pack from disk and resolves its brushes, the ones it scores.
lib/paint/studies: A study's page loads a pack's brushes from where Node served it.
lib/paint/gate: The gate's private run paints brushes read from an imported pack, resolved as a pack's brushes always are.
lib/paint/document: A painting source's still is painted on a page that loads the packs' brushes and paper from where Node served them.
